showcase.heading: Independent Development | Selected Work
showcase.intro: Since June 2025, independently building software products spanning data-driven applications, generative systems, creative technology and AI-assisted products.

name: Rajasekar C
title: Data Engineer
summary: Production Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience building, operating, automating, and troubleshooting high-volume production data systems. Strong in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, with hands-on experience in ETL pipelines, data ingestion, data modelling, schema design, and production reliability at approximately 50M records per day.

proof.text: Designed and operated production ETL pipelines at scale.
Built Flask and Pandas automation recognized with the Tech Titan Award.
Reduced the open production-data backlog from approximately 600 to under 70.

bullets: Design and build complete software products independently, from architecture to deployment, across web (Next.js, React, TypeScript), native iOS and macOS (Swift, SwiftUI) and generative-art applications; the web products run on Vercel under their own domains

Built OnchainRugs end to end: Solidity ERC721A contracts (Foundry), multi-chain wallet integration (wagmi, viem, RainbowKit), a deterministic p5-compatible renderer shared by browser, server and Puppeteer-generated previews, and a webhook that keeps an Upstash Redis cache in sync with chain events

Implemented backend and data workflows: Next.js server actions with Zod validation, Neon PostgreSQL persistence with SQL migrations and transactional email via Resend (Uravu), and GitHub OAuth on Vercel serverless functions for a Decap CMS content workflow (Valipokkann)

Developing Pocket Astro, an offline-first SwiftUI app for iOS and macOS on a native C and Swift calculation layer, checked against a Python oracle with golden fixtures and numerical parity tests; use Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot across design, implementation and testing
Owned the Vahan and Health business domains
Designed and operated ETL data pipelines processing approximately 50M records per day for high-volume batch data processing and downstream reporting
Built a Flask and Pandas automation tool that reduced Vahan issue resolution from approximately 30 minutes to under 1 minute, earning the Tech Titan Award
Resolved 4000+ production data issues and reduced the open backlog from approximately 600 to under 70
Owned PostgreSQL schema design and Git-versioned DDL; implemented PII classification and secure credential handling for data quality and compliant data handling
Automated MoEngage customer notification workflows with SQL stored procedures for policy-renewal detection, eliminating redundant alerts
Delivered ETL, data-ingestion, and schema work for Bima Satrak regulatory reporting; automated recurring credit-update and Excel-to-database ingestion with SQL and Pandas

context: BMO Capital Accounts: banking and capital accounts project
bullets: Built and maintained Oracle SQL and PL/SQL solutions, stored procedures, and production reports for banking and insurance data systems
Owned production support and database incident response, diagnosed root causes, and deployed fixes across client environments
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures to improve database performance under high-usage production workloads
Managed production database deployments, maintenance, and recovery across client environments

projects.title: Madras Checks
projects.description: Website for Madras Checks, a contemporary luxury textile house from Madras working with generative pattern, handloom craft, cotton, and natural dyes.
bullets: Built the site as a statically exportable Next.js application with unit tests for its content and data modules; the pattern generator is a separate system and is not part of this repository

projects.title: OnchainRugs
projects.description: Next.js application for minting, previewing, maintaining, and exploring generative on-chain rug NFTs tied to EVM smart contracts.
bullets: Developed the Solidity contracts (Foundry-based, with ERC721A and OpenZeppelin) and the Next.js front end with multi-chain wallet support (Base, Shape, Ethereum testnets)
Kept rug output deterministic across browser, export, and server-side flows with a minimal p5-compatible runtime; added a webhook that updates a Redis cache on chain events
Generated dynamic social-preview images by rendering rugs in headless Puppeteer

projects.title: Anekaroopam
projects.description: Digital art platform for multistable figurative emergence, including a browser-based Perception Engine for building rotational artworks.
bullets: Built the Perception Engine: import artwork, define perceptual states, rotate or snap between them, and export a standalone offline HTML file or a JSON configuration
Built an image-preparation tool that converts to AVIF, WebP, PNG, and JPEG in the browser using a Web Worker, with side-by-side comparison and size metrics

projects.title: Uravu
projects.description: Pre-launch waitlist site for Uravu, a product concept described as relational infrastructure for AI-mediated human connection.
bullets: Stores waitlist signups in Neon Postgres (SQL migration, unique lowercase emails) through a Next.js server action with Zod validation and a welcome email via Resend
Built an animated emotional-network background with React Three Fiber and structured SEO data (JSON-LD)

projects.title: Hard COpy
projects.description: Native handwritten notebook for iPadOS and macOS, tagline "Beyond Paper", built in Swift and SwiftUI.
bullets: Structured as an iPadOS and macOS app with a shared HardCopyCore Swift package, guided by written engineering specifications for ink input and filtering, stroke geometry, shape recognition, PDF pages, and undo/redo

projects.title: Rotate the Cow
projects.description: Low-stimulation iOS app where the user rotates a 3D cow with free-form circular finger gestures, designed as a bedtime alternative to scrolling.
bullets: Implemented gesture-driven 3D rotation in SwiftUI and RealityKit with optional haptics and ambient audio, Swift 6 strict concurrency, and local-only session tracking (no accounts, ads, or network required)

projects.title: Pocket Astro
projects.description: Offline-first native SwiftUI app for iOS and macOS that renders chart reports and dasha timelines from a Swift calculation kit.
bullets: Building a native calculation layer (C and Swift) and checking it against a Python oracle (wrapping the open-source PyJHora library) with golden fixtures and parity tests
Bundles a JPL DE440 ephemeris and a GeoNames place list with checksummed lock files; includes Lock Screen widgets and an optional on-device language model for a chart assistant

projects.title: Valipokkann
projects.description: Personal artist website with an art gallery, photography, articles, music, and a Thirukkural section with an image studio for social posts.
bullets: Built the site with content in YAML and Markdown managed through Decap CMS, with GitHub OAuth handled by Vercel serverless functions
Added lazy-loaded image galleries, Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights, and SEO metadata
